name: Spicy Chicken Ramen with Mushrooms, Carrots, Boiled Eggs & Green Onion (Two Ways)

ingredients.name: instant ramen noodle soup, chicken flavor

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.

Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Once the water is boiling, carefully add eggs. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and place eggs in a bowl with ice or run under cold water to cool. (Reserve pan for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb cremini mushrooms
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root
½ (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.

Peel, trim, and halve carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the baking sheet with the mushrooms, then drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces; peel and mince ginger. Place both in a small bowl and set aside.
When the eggs are done, add hot water (from the tap) to the reserved pan. Bring to a boil over high heat.
While the water comes to a boil, open ramen packages. Set seasoning packets aside for later use and reserve noodles for the next step.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (3 oz) pkg instant ramen noodle soup, chicken flavor

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, add noodles to the pan and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and halve eggs. Set aside.

When the noodles are done, remove 1 cup of cooked noodles, roughly chop, and place on a plate. Add a ½-cup of shredded chicken to the plate, then set aside for the kid plates (reserve remaining chicken for the next step).

Add green onions, ginger, reserved seasoning packets, remaining chicken, and chili-garlic sauce to the pan with the water and noodles, then stir to combine. Add spinach to the pan in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Once the spinach is fully wilted, remove ramen from heat.

FOR THE KID PLATES: Divide reserved noodles, chicken, a ½-cup veggies, and two eggs between plates. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide ramen between bowls, then top with remaining veggies and eggs. Enjoy!
